name: Mumble (app)
description: Mumble’s Windows snapshot hashes its binary for the version request and, in the snapshot-install path, calls WinVerifyTrust before showing the update prompt; this narrow observation does not cover other platforms or releases.
limitations: Newly retrieved default-branch snapshot; not historical release re-verification.
External updater-library behavior and released artifact signing/notarization remain outside the cited source unless directly shown.
